checks.name: Target reachable on budget
checks.reason: The plan buys $415K in pipeline against a $2M target, $1.59M short. It needs 800 leads and buys 166.
checks.fix: Add $153K at today's blended cost per lead of $241, bring the blended cost per lead down to $50, or cut the target to $415K.

checks.name: Opportunities land before the due date
checks.reason: Leads from the last 2 weeks land after May 31, 2027. Only $315K of pipeline lands in time against a $2M target.
checks.fix: Launch 2 weeks earlier, or move the due date to Jun 9, 2027.

checks.name: Every channel can buy at least one opportunity
checks.reason: Every channel buys at least one opportunity in the window.

checks.name: Sales capacity
checks.reason: Not run. Sales capacity was not given. The plan sends 9 opportunities a month.
checks.fix: Get the number of reps who will work these opportunities, and how many new opportunities each can take a month.

checks.name: Audience specific enough to target
checks.reason: "B2B companies that want to grow" names no industry, size or region. No list can be built from it.
checks.fix: Name the industry or an account list, a size band, a region, and the titles that buy.

checks.name: Offer fits the audience
checks.reason: The offer is a sales meeting with no value stated for the buyer.
checks.fix: Offer something the buyer keeps, and make booking the meeting the step after it.

checks.name: One provable message
checks.reason: Put a competitor's name in and the sentence still reads true. It names no specific result and gives no proof.
checks.fix: Name one result only Pillarmint delivers, for this audience, and the customer proof behind it.

checks.name: Channels reach the named buying roles
checks.reason: Google search ads say nothing about how they reach the buying roles.
checks.fix: Name the search terms and audience settings that put the ads in front of these roles.

checks.name: Tracking to pipeline defined
checks.reason: The strategy says nothing about how an opportunity gets credited to this campaign.
checks.fix: Name the CRM campaign and the rule that credits an opportunity to it.

checks.name: Risks named
checks.fix: Name the single point of failure, such as one channel carrying most of the budget, and give it an owner.
